name: Bunjaku Naru Anata ni Okuru Sousei Tan
original_name: 文弱なるあなたに贈る創世譚
source:
Sanjo Kotoha, a loner, begins writing a novel based on the people around
And he starts to get eroded by the novel he wrote.
translation:
